[UK-POL-11] Hartwell UK annual leave policy
Full-time staff receive 25 days of annual leave a year plus bank holidays. The leave year runs January to December. Up to 5 days may be carried into the next year with the line manager's approval.

[UK-POL-14] Hartwell UK overtime and weekend working, field and facilities staff
Overtime for field and facilities staff is paid at time and a half on weekdays and Saturdays and at double time on Sundays and bank holidays. Overtime must be agreed with the line manager in advance and recorded in the timesheet.

[UK-ER-05] Hartwell UK conduct procedure for managers
Before any conduct hearing, a manager not involved in the case holds an investigation meeting. The employee may be accompanied by a colleague or a trade union representative at a hearing. The outcome letter is sent within 5 working days, and an appeal may be made within 10 working days to a manager not previously involved.
